name: Distro 10 - 1.2g Injected Pre Roll - Strawberry Float
description:
Big flavor, extra kick. The Distro 10 Strawberry Float pre-roll is a 1.2-gram infused joint, packed with quality flower and injected with distillate and terpenes for a bolder, more potent smoke. No device, no charging, just spark and go.

Strawberry Float brings that soda-fountain nostalgia: sweet, ripe strawberry up front swirled with smooth vanilla cream and a light, fizzy finish. It's a sweet, easygoing smoke made for anyone who likes their sessions fruity, creamy, and full of flavor.

Why you'll love it:

1.2G infused pre-roll — quality flower injected with distillate and terpenes for extra potency
Bold Strawberry Float flavor — ripe strawberry swirled with smooth vanilla cream
Smooth, even burn — flavorful from the first pull to the last
Ready to enjoy — no setup, no battery, just light and go

Big flavor, dependable potency, and effortless convenience in one ready-to-smoke joint. Distro 10 Strawberry Float is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
